questions.stem: A triangle with area $36\text{ cm}^2$ is enlarged by scale factor $-\frac{1}{3}$. What is the area of the image?
questions.explanation: Area scales by $k^2$. Here $k^2 = \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{9}$. So the area is $36 \times \frac{1}{9} = 4\text{ cm}^2$. Area is always positive regardless of the sign of the scale factor.
